5195.title: Windows teardown rejects a terminated root before exit notification
5195.rootCauseOneLine: The Windows helper rejects after one second without exit notification even when the root is gone; managed stop separately requires exit metadata. Verified in a delayed-notification model, not native Windows.
5195.proposedFix: First capture native Windows liveness and exit/close timing. If confirmed, align bounded root-termination checks in the Windows helper and managed-stop wrapper, retain descendant verification, and investigate the CLI assertion separately.
5195.caveats: Only the modeled helper state is reproduced. Native Windows turn submission, retry recovery, descendant cleanup, and the native CLI assertion remain unverified. No automatic fix PR is safe.
